description:
I left an AI agent running for 24 hours straight and never checked on it once. It migrated a whole test suite while I was gone, work that would've taken me weeks by hand. The trick is /goal: the agent keeps looping until your verification passes, so the real job becomes writing that verification before you walk away. Get it wrong and you'll burn a full day on confident garbage. That's the catch nobody talks about.
